title: Cauvery Peak — coffee, from the estate itself
desc: Coffee grown, processed and roasted at 4,600 ft in the Shevaroy Hills, Yercaud. A working single-estate plantation farmed by the same family for five generations.

title: Grower to Connoisseur — Cauvery Peak
desc: Nine stages from seed to cup, every one of them on our own estate in the Shevaroy Hills. This is what single estate actually means.

title: Visit the estate — Cauvery Peak, Yercaud
desc: Walk a 150-year-old working coffee plantation in Yercaud. A 75-minute guided tour through the mills and roasting room, ending with a tasting.

title: The coffee — Cauvery Peak
desc: Three single estates at three elevations in the Shevaroy Hills, and two blends made from them. Estate grown, estate processed, estate roasted.

title: Our cafés — Cauvery Peak, Yercaud
desc: Three places to drink our coffee in Yercaud: the estate café on the plantation, Lake View Village on the main road, and the Glenfell kiosk on the ghat.

title: A legacy of 150 years — Cauvery Peak
desc: From an 1867 land assignment in the Shevaroy Hills to five generations of the Rajes family growing coffee at Cauvery Peak, Shevaroys and Glenfell.

title: The people behind the estate — Cauvery Peak
desc: MSP Plantations is a family-owned coffee business in the Shevaroy Hills. We grow it, process it, roast it and send it to you.

title: The ecosystem behind the coffee — Cauvery Peak
desc: Two tiers of shade, harvested rainwater, vermicompost and a resident population of birds and mammals. How the estate physically works.

title: Brew better coffee — Cauvery Peak
desc: Six ways to brew estate coffee: Indian filter, pour over, moka pot, French press, cold brew and AeroPress. Doses, temperatures and timings.

title: Find your grind — Cauvery Peak
desc: Match your grind size to your brewing method. A guide from extra coarse for cold brew to extra fine for Turkish coffee.

title: In the press — Cauvery Peak
desc: The Shevaroy Hills in print since 1922, and Cauvery Peak in Indian Coffee Magazine, Discover India and Kenneth Davids' writing on coffee.

title: Contact — Cauvery Peak
desc: Come and visit the estate, book a tour, or talk to us about wholesale. MSP Plantations, Yercaud, Tamil Nadu.
